briefing:
Fifteen souls, one failing block, zero patience from port authority. You are the embarrassing private option that still has air tanks.

Nav: "I mapped three warm vents. Pick the ones with people, not fauna."

beats.insert: INTERCOM // Tinny sobbing, then hold music. Somebody survived long enough to get bitter. O2 scrubbers cough like smokers.
beats.complication: RADIO // Unregistered tug on the scope. Salvage rivals or volunteers? Either way they are closer to the galley deck.
beats.crisis: SENSOR // Life signs flicker in pairs. Xen activity spikes where the survivors holed up. You cannot herd people and fight on the same breath.

debrief.win: Fifteen becomes fourteen plus one apology for a sprained ankle. Rep bumps. Cookie makes stew that counts as celebration.
debrief.partial: You got most of them out. Port will call it negligence. Survivors call you saviors anyway, which almost balances.
debrief.fail: Empty shuttle, heavy hearts. Independence rep takes a hit. Crew agrees not to mention it until the mugs are empty.
